def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    obs = observe()
    obj = obs["objects"][obj_name]
    zone = obs["zones"][zone_name]

    # Check if the zone is free for the object
    zone_free = free_spots(zone["name"], obj_name)
    if not zone_free["spots"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{zone_name} is occupied or no valid spot for {obj_name}.")

    # Get grasp candidates for the object
    candidates = grasp_candidates(obj_name)
    if not candidates:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No valid grasp candidates for {obj_name}.")

    candidate = candidates[0]  # Use the first valid candidate

    # Grasp the object
    grasp_result = grasp(candidate)
    if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to grasp {obj_name}.")

    # Select the first free spot in the zone
    spot = zone_free["spots"][0]

    # Compute required gripper yaw to align object's long axis with zone's long axis
    target_long_axis_yaw = zone["long_axis_yaw"]
    current_obj_long_axis_yaw = candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
    gripper_yaw_at_grasp = candidate["yaw"]
    required_gripper_yaw = target_long_axis_yaw + (gripper_yaw_at_grasp - current_obj_long_axis_yaw)

    # Carry to the spot with correct orientation
    carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=required_gripper_yaw)

    # Lower until contact
    lower_until_contact()

    # Release the object
    open_gripper()

    # Retreat and verify placement
    retreat()
    check(obj_name, zone_name)
